changes: Two optional paid revives per journey: 500 gold, then 1000 gold. Revive with half health and three seconds of protection. Banked and journey gold can pay; after both, death is final.
Hero XP rewards increased by 25%; gem XP by 10%; power-up supply crates arrive 15% more frequently.
New journeys begin with zero ritual charge. Existing journeys keep their charge.
Resin Web fires two visible projectiles before spreading its webs, with 25% stronger damage per web.
Health uses consistent rounding, so fractional maximum health can no longer display as 101/100.
